grammar_focus: 被动语态(主考:be + 过去分词表'被…' · 一般时被动 is/was built · 情态被动 can/must/will + be + 过去分词 · 现在完成被动 has been done · must have been + 过去分词——对过去的被动推测 · by 引出施动者)+ 现在分词作定语 / 本课短语(辅考:passing planes 过往的飞机 · drive sb mad 逼疯 · be determined to 决心)
scene: 住在机场附近,过往飞机日夜不绝于耳、快把人逼疯;一百多邻居被噪音赶走,有人出大价钱让我搬走——但我决心留下,大家都说我一定是疯了

grammar_card.title: 说'某事被…'(被动语态 be + 过去分词)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲被动语态——主语是动作的承受者('被…')。构成:be + 过去分词。跟 can/must/will 一起用时是 can/must/will + be + 过去分词;'肯定已被…了'用 must have been + 过去分词。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 被动 = be + 过去分词('被…')
The airport was built years ago.
can / must / will + be + 过去分词
Passing planes can be heard night and day.
现在完成的被动:has / have been + 过去分词
I have been offered a large sum of money.
'肯定已被…了'= must have been + 过去分词
A hundred people must have been driven away.

specialRules.rule: '被谁做的'用 by 引出:The thieves will be arrested by the police.
passing planes:passing 是现在分词作定语,'过往的飞机'

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why do people think the writer is mad?
options: Because he refuses to leave a house near a noisy airport
Because he cannot hear the planes
Because he wants to build an airport
Because he has too much money

passage: Airplanes are slowly driving me mad. I live near an airport, and passing planes can be heard night and day. The airport was built years ago, but for some reason it could not be used then. Last year, however, it came into use. Over a hundred people must have been driven away from their homes by the noise. Most of my neighbors have already left, and I am one of the few people who stay. Sometimes I think this house will be knocked down by a passing plane. I have been offered a large sum of money to go away, but I am determined to stay here. Everybody says I must be mad, and they are probably right.

stage5.stem: 被动语态的基本构成是:
"The airport ___ built years ago."(过去被动:被建造)
"This room ___ cleaned every day."(一般现在被动:被打扫)
"English ___ spoken here."(一般现在被动:被说)

options: 情态动词 + be + 过去分词
情态动词 + 过去分词
情态动词 + being + 过去分词
情态动词 + have + 过去分词

stage5.stem: "Passing planes can ___ heard."(情态被动:能被听到)
